notes: Type AB tapping screw. AMK B-12081 lists it with 3841230 and 9428469. GMPartsWiki says REPLACED BY 9419305. NSN 5305-01-197-2536 (tapping screw). Vendors use it for heater box Y-duct (63-67 Corvette), door access plate (68-82), and Camaro heater resistor. Quotes come from search snippets.
